description: Lightweight, breathable, and built for everyday wear — this tee carries a bold, tongue-in-cheek message that starts conversations. The soft Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton feels gentle against the skin while the retail crew fit keeps the silhouette clean and easy to layer. Retro comic-style faces and crisp, monochrome lettering sit on the front, delivering a dry, sardonic humor that lands in casual meetups, coffee runs, or relaxed rallies. Thoughtful details like side seams, a ribbed knit collar with seam, shoulder tape, and a tear-away label keep the shirt comfortable and long-wearing. Ethically produced and REACH certified, this tee pairs well with jeans or a jacket when you want to show personality without shouting. Product features - 100% Airlume combed ring-spun cotton for a soft, breathable feel - Retail crew fit with side seams and ribbed knit collar for lasting shape - Prints produced using DTF/DTG methods for crisp, detailed graphics - Tear-away label, shoulder tape, and ethical manufacturing certifications - REACH certified; blank sourced from Honduras with blended color options available Care instructions - Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F) - Non-chlorine: bleach as needed - Tumble dry: low heat - Iron, steam or dry: medium heat - Do not dryclean
